items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 132:1
items.html:
(to the question) The forming of the fetus
The forming of the fetus is made by the phase of the redness of Ima, which is the phase of the coarseness and the screens upon which the coupling is made, that establish the level and conclude each and every organ of ZA in its form. (Part 1, Page 133, Item 21).
